services.name: Destin Tiki Boat Rentals
services.desc: Make your next Destin getaway unforgettable aboard our Crab Island party cruise. Our private Destin tiki boat rentals feature shaded seating, an experienced captain, and everything you need for a carefree day on the water. Sip, laugh, and enjoy every moment surrounded by emerald waves. Step aboard the Tipsy Tiki with friends and family for a relaxed escape on the water! A licensed captain and crew guide every trip, with bottled water, floats, lily pad, restrooms, and life vests provided. Guests bring their own snacks, beverages, and cameras to capture the fun! services.name: Pontoon Boats
services.desc: You’ll have the time of your life experiencing Destin’s unique feature Crab Island! You may even catch a glimpse of or get to play in the water with some friendly sea life! Take one of our Destin Pontoon Boat Rentals from Destin to Crab Island, while there people have watched dolphins play, sea turtles swim & stingrays glide! At Crab Island there are plenty of things to enjoy, the shallow areas where you can swim in the middle of the pass. Crab Island is truly an experience of a lifetime. If our Destin Double Decker Pontoon Boat Rentals are available you can jump off the top or go down the slides right into the beautiful sea water! services.name: Destin Sunset Dolphin Tours
services.desc: There is a particular moment, about an hour before the sun touches the horizon, when the Emerald Coast turns gold and the bay goes quiet. The boats thin out, the breeze settles, and the dolphins start to feed. That is when a Destin sunset dolphin tour is at its absolute best - and that is when you should be on the water with us. At Gilligan’s Watersports, our guided sunset dolphin tour pairs golden-hour Destin scenery with a real shot at meeting wild Atlantic bottlenose dolphins. You ride out with a local captain, follow the dolphins at a respectful distance, and watch the sky do its best work overhead.
